name: UPSC
fullName: UPSC Civil Services, CDS, NDA and other UPSC exams
intro: UPSC asks for a recent photograph and a single image containing three signatures, one below the other.

documents.label: Photograph
documents.caption: optional
notes: Plain white background; your face should cover most of the photo.
If the portal asks you to capture a live photo with your camera, use that instead.

documents.label: Signature (three times)
notes: Sign three times, one below the other, on plain white paper in black ink, then photograph or scan the page.
Typed or digital signatures are not accepted.

source.label: Summary of UPSC 2027 photo and signature guidelines (coaching-site summary, check the UPSC instructions)

faqs.q: What is the UPSC photo size in KB?
faqs.a: JPG between 20 KB and 200 KB. UPSC does not fix exact pixel dimensions in the summary we checked, so this tool uses a standard passport ratio of 3.5 × 4.5 cm.

faqs.q: How do I make the UPSC triple signature?
faqs.a: Sign three times, one below the other, on white paper in black ink. Photograph the page, upload it here, and the tool trims the empty paper and fits it between 20 KB and 100 KB.
